findings.description: Null destinationCalendar drops collective hosts' calendars — When an organizer has no calendar configured, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...)` silently skips adding `teamDestinationCalendars`. Default `destinationCalendar` to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` to preserve collective host calendars.

Inverted IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED check for organization slug — Organizations created with team billing disabled are left without a `slug`. Restore `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {}` so the organization receives its slug directly.

Unchecked access to mainHostDestinationCalendar causes TypeError — An empty `evt.destinationCalendar` causes `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` to throw an unhandled `TypeError` when checking `MeetLocationType`. Use optional chaining on `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.integration` to guard against `undefined`.

`selectedCalendar` fallback matches against falsy `externalCalendarId` — Matching against a falsy `externalCalendarId` always evaluates to `undefined`, leaving `selectedCalendar` unset. Fall back directly to `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` instead.

**Also found in:**
- `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:315-317`
- `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:315-318`

`isTeamAdminOrOwner` uses logical AND instead of OR — Because a user cannot be both an admin and an owner simultaneously, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` always evaluates to `false`. Replace `&&` with `||` so either role is permitted.

Unfiltered guests array passed to sendAddGuestsEmails — Existing attendees present in `guests` will be misidentified as new guests and sent `AttendeeScheduledEmail` instead of `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`. Pass `uniqueGuests` to `sendAddGuestsEmails` instead.

Hardcoded refresh token dummy string overwrites stored credentials — Merging this result overwrites and permanently corrupts valid OAuth refresh tokens in the database. Remove the fallback assignment so `refresh_token` is omitted when absent.

Credential key updated with SafeParseReturnType instead of parsed data — Storing the wrapper object in the database corrupts the credential record and breaks subsequent calendar operations. Destructure `data` from `parseRefreshTokenResponse` so only the parsed credential payload is passed to `prisma.credential.update`.

refreshOAuthTokens receives credential ID instead of user ID — Passing a credential record ID prevents the sync endpoint from locating the Cal.com user. Pass `credential.userId` to `refreshOAuthTokens` instead of `credentialId`.

Raw fetch Response returned instead of response data expected by callers — Returning a raw `Response` lacks the `.data` property expected by callers, causing unhandled `TypeError` exceptions when accessing tokens. Parse the response body with `await response.json()` before returning it.

Header lookup fails if CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME has uppercase characters — Node normalizes incoming header names to lowercase, causing lookup failures if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` contains uppercase characters. Call `.toLowerCase()` on the header key before indexing `req.headers`.

Insecure fallback to empty string for encryption key — Decrypting with an empty string compromises security when the environment variable is unset. Reject the request early if `process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is missing instead of falling back to `""`.

Invalid `[z.string().toString()]` key in Zod schema strips response properties — Evaluating `toString()` creates a static `"[object Object]"` key, causing Zod to strip token expiry fields from the response. Chain `.passthrough()` onto `minimumTokenResponseSchema` instead of defining computed schema keys.

Timing attack vulnerability in webhook secret comparison — Comparing secrets with `!==` leaks timing information that allows attackers to guess the secret token. Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` for a constant-time comparison instead.

Retry count cleanup deletes non-SMS workflow reminders — Reminders for `EMAIL` or `WHATSAPP` with `retryCount > 1` are inadvertently deleted because `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` only scopes the first `OR` branch. Move `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to the top-level `where` clause alongside `OR` so both conditions apply only to SMS reminders.

NoMethodError when feed item content is nil — Feed items that omit content abort the scheduled poll job when `scrub` is called on `nil`. Check that `i.content` is present before calling `scrub` and `CGI.unescapeHTML`.
Syntax error from invalid `<%- end if %>` tag — ERB compilation fails and crashes the view whenever comments render. Replace `<%- end if %>` with `<%- end %>` to close the conditional block.

Test 'requires feed_polling_url' does not enable feed polling — Because `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` defaults to `false`, `execute` short-circuits early and creates a false positive even if URL validation breaks. Stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to `true` and supply `embed_by_username`.

Test does not stub feed_polling_enabled? or feed_polling_url — Because `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` defaults to `false`, `execute` short-circuits early and passes even if username checks break. Stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to `true` and configure `feed_polling_url`.

Full URL passed as postMessage targetOrigin fails origin match — Passing the full URL from `request.referer` fails origin matching or throws a `SyntaxError`, blocking `discourse-resize` messages. Pass `'*'` or a parsed origin to `parent.postMessage` instead.

NoMethodError when indexing query results without checking row presence — If `embed_category` or `uncategorized_category_id` returns no rows, indexing `[0]` raises `NoMethodError`. Verify the query results are present before reading `['id']` or `['value']`.

Obsolete test for blank embeddable_host in Topic#expandable_first_post? — `Topic#expandable_first_post?` no longer checks embeddable hosts, so this test passes vacuously regardless of host state. Remove this spec or update it to test `SiteSetting.embed_truncate?` and `has_topic_embed?`.

NoMethodError when host is nil in before_validation callback — A blank or missing `self.host` causes `sub!` to raise `NoMethodError`, crashing with a 500 error instead of validation failures. Guard the mutations with `if self.host.present?`.

Invalid ImageMagick resize geometry and stale tempfile size in downsize loop — Appending `\>` to `"80%"` produces invalid ImageMagick geometry, and `tempfile.size` caches the initial file size so the loop cannot terminate early. Use pixel dimensions for `OptimizedImage.downsize` and check `File.size(tempfile.path)` on each iteration.

Duplicate method definition overwrites OptimizedImage.downsize — Ruby lacks method overloading, so callers like `Jobs::ResizeEmoji` expecting the 5-parameter signature will raise an `ArgumentError`. Merge both parameter signatures into a single `downsize` method that handles either argument structure.

`remove_member` expects nonexistent `group_id` parameter — Requests fail with `ActionController::ParameterMissing` because member routes provide `params[:id]` rather than `params[:group_id]`. Update `remove_member` to read `params.require(:id)`.

**Also found in:**
- `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:66-70`
- `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:84-86`

Duplicate or existing group members cause unhandled database exception — Submitting existing or duplicate usernames triggers a unique constraint violation on `index_group_users_on_group_id_and_user_id`, resulting in an unhandled 500 error. Check membership with `group.users.include?(user)` before calling `group.add(user)`.

totalPages overcounts when user_count is an exact multiple of limit — Users can paginate to an empty page when `user_count` divides evenly by `limit`. Replace the `Math.floor` calculation with `Math.ceil`.

Device cached before CreateOrUpdateDevice validation completes — Blocked devices exceeding `deviceLimit` can bypass authentication on subsequent requests because `tagDeviceUI` returns `nil` on cache hits. Populate `localCache` only after `CreateOrUpdateDevice` succeeds, or evict the key on error.

Outer args slice mutated in retried WithDbSession callback — Retrying the transaction on lock contention prepends duplicate `query` elements to `args`, causing execution to fail with argument mismatch errors. Pass `query` directly to `dbSession.Exec` instead of prepending it to `args`.

TOCTOU race condition in device limit check — Concurrent requests can all see the count below `deviceLimit` and insert simultaneously, exceeding the configured limit. Move `CountDevices` and the insert into a single transaction with appropriate locking.

Unbound int64 in ProvideAnonDBStore breaks Wire provider set — Wire code generation fails because it cannot resolve the unbound `deviceLimit int64` parameter registered in `pkg/server/wire.go`. Update or remove the `anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore` registration in `wire.go` since `ProvideAnonymousDeviceService` now instantiates it directly.

Context cancellation aborts asynchronous legacy write — Propagating request context cancellation aborts background writes as soon as the HTTP handler returns. Wrap `ctx` with `context.WithoutCancel` before calling `context.WithTimeoutCause`.

High metric cardinality from passing object name instead of kind — Using individual resource names causes metric cardinality explosion and excessive memory consumption in Prometheus. Pass `options.Kind` instead of `name` to `d.recordStorageDuration`.

Create storage error recorded under legacy metric instead of storage — This misattributes storage failures and latency to the legacy storage metric. Call `d.recordStorageDuration` instead of `d.recordLegacyDuration` when `d.Storage.Create` fails.

**Also found in:**
- `pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:128-130`
- `pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:165-167`

Concurrent index creation causes storage conflicts and race conditions — Concurrent calls to `bleve.New` for the same key will collide on the directory path, corrupting index files and leaking duplicate indices. Keep `b.cacheMu` locked across the entire build or synchronize creation with a per-key lock.

Missing key prop on GrafanaRuleListItem — Without item identity tracking inside `rules.map`, React can hit reconciliation bugs and retain stale state as filtered results update. Pass `key={key}` to `<GrafanaRuleListItem>`.

rawTokenId validation checks grantType instead of rawTokenId — This leaves `rawTokenId` unvalidated while checking `grantType` with a mismatched error message. Pass `rawTokenId` to `Objects.requireNonNull` instead.

Inverted condition and incorrect substring range in isAccessTokenId — Valid access token IDs are rejected because the check inspects the wrong characters and returns `false` upon matching `expectedGrantShortcut`. Invert the condition and slice indices 4 to 6 after verifying `items[0]` length.

Return of null from getSubGroupsCount can cause NullPointerException — Callers auto-unboxing the return value to `long` will throw a `NullPointerException` when `model` is null. Return `0L` instead of `null` to satisfy the `GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount` contract.

Background reader thread is not joined before assertions — Assertions can run while the reader thread is still active, missing late exceptions and causing false test passes. Store the thread in a variable and call `join()` before checking `caughtExceptions`.

Unescaped hyphen in `[a-zA-Z-_]` creates unexpected character range — The regex treats `Z-_` as an ASCII range instead of a literal hyphen, preventing hyphenated locale codes from matching. Move the hyphen to the end of the character class as `[a-zA-Z_-]` or escape it.

Unsupported MessageFormat syntax used in i18next message property — Using Java `MessageFormat` syntax in `error-invalid-multivalued-size` breaks i18next localization, displaying raw placeholders and choice expressions directly to users. Switch back to `{{0}}` interpolation placeholders and replace the choice format with static wording.

**Also found in:**
- `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138-3138`

Unconstrained end index calculation causes StringIndexOutOfBoundsException — Overlapping prefix and suffix matches can cause `length - end` to fall below `start`, throwing a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` in `substring()`. Constrain `end` in the loop condition using `sanitized.length() - start` and `value.length() - start`.

Client removal fails with UnsupportedOperationException under V2 authz — `ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled()` unconditionally throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, aborting client deletion when V2 fine-grained authorization is enabled. Guard this call by checking whether `Profile.Feature.ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2` is disabled.

canManage(ClientModel) checks role directly instead of calling canManage() — Callers granted permission to manage all clients are denied managing individual clients that have a dedicated resource in `resourceStore`. Replace the `root.hasOneAdminRole(AdminRoles.MANAGE_CLIENTS)` check with a call to `canManage()`.

Falsy age or timestamp bypasses field mutual exclusion validation — Falsy values like `0` cause `self.initial_data.get()` to treat present fields as absent and bypass mutual exclusion checks. Move this cross-field validation into `validate` and check presence using `in self.initial_data`.

Error IDs misaligned with event payloads when zipping with events.values() — Pairing `error_ids` with `events.values()` misaligns or drops data when entries are missing or unordered. Look up each payload directly from `events` using its corresponding `node_id` instead.

Expired deadline skips terminating remaining flusher processes — Breaking early leaves subsequent entries in `self.processes` running as orphaned background processes. Remove the early `break` check so each process is terminated even after `deadline` expires.

Patched time.sleep makes wait a no-op — Because `time.sleep` is patched to a no-op earlier in the test, this returns immediately and introduces race conditions. Synchronize on an event or use an unpatched sleep instead.

assignment_source added to sync_status_outbound instead of sync_assignee_outbound — Callers in `sync_assignee_outbound.py` pass `assignment_source` to `sync_assignee_outbound`, which will fail because the parameter is missing there. Move `assignment_source` from `sync_status_outbound` to `sync_assignee_outbound`.

AssignmentSource.queued evaluated at class definition time — Every `AssignmentSource` instance receives the same static startup timestamp instead of its actual creation time. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` on `queued` so it evaluates dynamically at instantiation.

OAuth state uses static pipeline signature enabling CSRF — An attacker can bypass CSRF validation and link an arbitrary GitHub account to a victim session because `pipeline.signature` is predictable. Generate a cryptographically secure random token, store it with `pipeline.bind_state`, and validate the callback `state` against it.

Original monitor config returned instead of modified copy — The updated schedule display is discarded because the untransformed configuration dictionary is returned. Return `config` instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`.
